summary: This line chart compares the maximum utility achieved over time between LLM-based and Template-based methods. The x-axis represents time in minutes, while the y-axis shows the maximum utility. The chart includes two lines, one for each method, with shaded areas indicating the standard deviation. Key p-values are marked at various time intervals, highlighting statistical significance. The LLM-based method generally shows a slightly higher utility over time compared to the Template-based method, with both methods converging towards similar utility levels by the 15-minute mark.
